name: Multi-Turn Mind2Web (MT-Mind2Web)
description: MT-Mind2Web is a dataset designed for the task of Conversational Web Navigation, requiring multi-turn interactions between users and web environments. It benchmarks the ability of models to follow sequential user instructions in complex web-based tasks.
reputation: A newer benchmark derived from Mind2Web that is used in the web-agent community to test multi-turn conversational navigation, but it is not yet as widely established as older web navigation benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn conversational web navigation; includes a novel framework Self-MAP for memory-augmented planning.
